scripts.build: pnpm contracts:build && pnpm --filter @resolve-signal/api build && pnpm --filter @resolve-signal/web build
scripts.dev: pnpm contracts:build && concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "pnpm --filter @resolve-signal/api dev" "pnpm --filter @resolve-signal/web dev"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm contracts:build && pnpm --filter @resolve-signal/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @resolve-signal/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @resolve-signal/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm contracts:build && pnpm --filter @resolve-signal/contracts test && pnpm --filter @resolve-signal/api test && pnpm --filter @resolve-signal/web test
